verdict.rationale: CloudConvert documents a built-in AI capability: you describe in natural language what should happen with your files and an AI model carries it out. That is a first-party way to delegate tasks to AI, but the only evidence is a single line, and it does not say whether this is an interactive assistant in the product UI or an API task type. The MCP integration (docs-20) lets external assistants call CloudConvert, so it is not a built-in assistant and is not credited here. Missing for 10: confirmation that it is an in-product assistant interface, details on scope and limits of delegated tasks, multi-step or conversational delegation, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product

citations.quote: Describe what should happen with your files, and an AI model takes care of it.
